answer: Copying the same citations across 146 aliases hence pays the reading cost 146 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the comet check immediately, the marble audit keeps the resolved set and the delta replay makes public exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
